name: Gundren Rockseeker

appearance.build: Barrel-chested dwarf, shorter than Mira but twice as wide
appearance.hair: Braided chestnut beard, now matted with dirt from captivity
appearance.face: One eye swollen half-shut, split lip — and grinning anyway
appearance.overall: Beaten, furious, and absolutely delighted to be holding a weapon again

features.name: Fighting Style: Great Weapon Fighting
features.detail: Reroll 1s and 2s on damage dice with a two-handed weapon (keep the new roll)

features.name: Action Surge
features.detail: Take one additional action on your turn

features.name: Dwarven Resilience
features.detail: Advantage on saves vs poison; resistance to poison damage

features.name: Darkvision
features.detail: See in dim light within 60 ft as if bright light

features.name: Stonecunning
features.detail: Add double proficiency to History checks about stonework

inventory.item: Map tube — MAP TO WAVE ECHO CAVE

traits: Talks big, laughs loud, means every word.
Knows the worth of everything — rocks, gear, people — at a glance.
Days of captivity gave him a very specific list of goblins he wants a word with.
ideals: A Rockseeker pays his debts, and these two children of adventure just bought his life.
bonds: His brothers Nundro and Tharden are camped at Wave Echo Cave, unaware they're hunted. Nothing matters more.
The map. The Forge of Spells is his family's birthright.
flaws: Reckless when angry, and right now he is VERY angry.

notes: GUEST PC session 5 (played by Mitch) — NPC AGAIN from session 6. Rescued from Grol's tower, fought out, rigged the bridge rockslide (nat 20), carries the MAP to Wave Echo Cave. Wants: Phandalin, warn Sildar, reach Nundro + Tharden. Voice: loud, warm, pays his debts, very specific grudge list. Use this sheet as his stat block.
